tests.name: TestNewNodeRedClient_DeployedAttemptSettings
tests.asserts: client built from NODE_RED_TIMEOUT=30, NODE_RED_MAX_RETRIES=3, NODE_RED_RETRY_DELAY_MS=1000 -> 30s attempt timeout, 3 attempts, 1s apart

tests.name: TestFetchCPEStatus_TimeoutIsRetried
tests.asserts: an attempt that runs past the timeout is retried: a slow Node-RED is called exactly 3 times, then a timeout failure

tests.name: TestFetchCPEStatus_SameWaitBetweenAttempts
tests.asserts: with a 150ms delay, both waits between the 3 attempts are at least the delay and the second is not longer than the first (no exponential backoff)

tests.name: TestFetchCPEStatus_GivesUpAfterMaxRetries
tests.asserts: 500, 502 or broken JSON on every call -> exactly NODE_RED_MAX_RETRIES (3) calls, then a retryable error

tests.name: TestFetchCPEStatus_UnknownCPEIsNotRetried
tests.asserts: a 404 -> ERR_CPE_NOT_FOUND after 1 call (not retried)

tests.name: TestRetryDisabled_FetchFailureClosesRunWithoutSavingIt
tests.asserts: RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false (deployed config, child process): fetch failure -> no retry job, run FETCHING_CPE_STATUS -> FAILED_PERMANENT with cpe_fetch_failed_retry_disabled and the error as reason, nothing published (RT untouched)

tests.name: TestNodeRedSleepFreesSlot
tests.asserts: a failed first call is retried after a fixed sleep and then succeeds (2 attempts, 300ms delay)

tests.name: TestNewNodeRedClient_InvalidConfig
tests.asserts: client refuses missing/zero NODE_RED_MAX_RETRIES and NODE_RED_TIMEOUT

tests.name: TestGuard_FetchFailureSchedulesRetryFromFetching
tests.asserts: with retry worker ON (test default) a fetch failure SAVES a retry job - the opposite of the AC's deployed config

how_mm: FetchCPEStatus က NODE_RED_MAX_RETRIES (=3) ကြိမ်အထိ loop ပတ်ပြီး ကြိမ်တိုင်းကြား NODE_RED_RETRY_DELAY_MS (=1000ms) တည်ငြိမ်စွာ စောင့်သည် (backoff မရှိ)။ http.Client Timeout = NODE_RED_TIMEOUT (=30s)။ RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false ဆိုရင် scheduleRetry က retry job မသိမ်းဘဲ run ကို FAILED_PERMANENT ပိတ်သည်။ 404 (CPE not found) ဆိုရင် ထပ်ခေါ်လည်း အဖြေ မပြောင်းလို့ retry မလုပ်ဘဲ ၁ ကြိမ်တည်းနဲ့ CPE_NOT_FOUND ပိတ်တယ် — PO အတည်ပြုပြီး (2026-11-28)။
note_en: All tested: 30 s timeout, a timed-out attempt retried, exactly 3 attempts, the same wait between them (no backoff), nothing saved with retries off. A 404 (CPE not found) is not retried and closes as CPE_NOT_FOUND, as the PO confirmed on 2026-11-28.

tests.name: TestRetryDisabled_FetchFailureClosesRunWithoutSavingIt
tests.asserts: RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false (deployed config, child process): fetch failure -> no retry job, run FETCHING_CPE_STATUS -> FAILED_PERMANENT with cpe_fetch_failed_retry_disabled and the error as reason, nothing published (RT untouched)

tests.name: TestNocAutomationReport_RunItems
tests.asserts: a finished non-completed run (API_UNREACHABLE, ALREADY_PROCESSED) is reported as 'Manual Check'

tests.name: TestPipelineReportRepository_QueryRunsByStatus_RTSideFailed/manual_check
tests.asserts: manual_check card SQL includes FAILED_PERMANENT

how_mm: Node-RED retry ကုန်ရင် error log ရေးပြီး RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false ဖြစ်လို့ run ကို FAILED_PERMANENT (event cpe_fetch_failed_retry_disabled) ပိတ်သည်။ Report က FAILED_PERMANENT ကို 'Manual Check' အဖြစ် ပြသည်။ RT ကို မထိပါ။ RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false (deploy config) နဲ့ fetch fail → FAILED_PERMANENT ပိတ်ပြီး Kafka မပို့ (RT မထိ) ကို test စစ်တယ်။
note_en: With the deployed RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false, a failed fetch closes the run FAILED_PERMANENT (cpe_fetch_failed_retry_disabled) without publishing; the report maps it to Manual Check.

functions.name: evaluateStep (Node-RED error checked before the condition)

tests.name: TestWorkflowEngine_NodeRedJobFailedSetsNodeRedError
tests.asserts: olt.status error 2002 -> onu_error_event: queue = config's onu_error_event queue, comment = mapped error message, node_red_error set in Kafka JSON

tests.asserts: unmapped error code uses fallback message

tests.name: TestRules_NewCustomerAndUsageEdges/missing usage (2008) takes the error route
tests.asserts: missing usage (false + error 2008) takes onu_error_event (NOC, Customer Site, Customer-ONU), not low usage

tests.name: TestRules_FailedJobBeforeFalseCondition
tests.asserts: ONU offline + failed EPC outage job (false + error) takes onu_error_event, not ONU Down

tests.name: TestProcessTicket_NodeRedErrorRunIsManualCheck
tests.asserts: after the RT update: node_red_error → FAILED_PERMANENT / node_red_job_failed with the job error as reason (Manual Check); a routing rule → TICKET_COMPLETED / rt_updated; ticket_status In_Progress

how_mm: Engine က step မကိုက်ပြီး api_error_enabled field ရဲ့ value ဗလာ + Node-RED errors ထဲမှာ အဲဒီ datasource_path ရှိရင် onu_error_event (NOC, In Progress, SAI Customer Site, RCC Customer-ONU, error message comment) ထုတ်ပြီး node_red_error ထည့်သည်။ rtutil က ticket update ပြီး run ကို FAILED_PERMANENT (Manual Check) မှတ်သည်။
gap_mm: ကွာဟချက် မရှိတော့ပါ။ Error route (NOC/SAI/RCC/comment/node_red_error)၊ error 2008၊ rule မလိုတဲ့ field error ကို လျစ်လျူရှုတာ၊ rtutil က node_red_error ရှိရင် FAILED_PERMANENT (Manual Check) ရွေးတာ အကုန် test ရှိပြီ။ Status In Progress ကို rtutil က New ticket မှာ ထားတယ် (AC36)။
note_en: Covered: engine error route (checked before each step's condition), error 2008, unneeded-field errors ignored, and rtutil choosing FAILED_PERMANENT for node_red_error are all tested.

tests.name: TestFetchCPEStatus_FailureSaysWhatFailed
tests.asserts: Node-RED error status / unreadable answer / timeout / unreachable -> APIFailure node_red with kind http_status / invalid_response / timeout / unreachable, 3 attempts, cpe_id, HTTP status for an error status; message unchanged; event detail carries them

tests.name: TestRetryDisabled_FailedRunRecordHasRequiredFields
tests.asserts: with retries off, the FAILED_PERMANENT event of a Node-RED failure has detail {api node_red, kind, attempts 3, cpe_id, http_status, error} and of a Kafka failure {api kafka, kind, attempts 3, topic, error}, reason = the error

tests.name: TestFailedAPIRequestSync_Records
tests.asserts: RT External API failure (rt_web_ui quarantine) recorded as API_UNREACHABLE with reason, failed_at, event api_unreachable and detail (source, key, cpe_id, root_cause)

tests.name: TestRecordBCSFailure_LeavesIsBCSSuccessNull
tests.asserts: CPEMS request error recorded as bcs_update_failed with the error as bcs_status_message

how_mm: Node-RED client က attempt အကုန် fail ရင် APIFailure (api node_red၊ kind timeout/unreachable/http_status/invalid_response၊ attempts၊ cpe_id၊ http_status) ပြန်ပေးတယ်။ RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false မှာ run ကို FAILED_PERMANENT (cpe_fetch_failed_retry_disabled) ပိတ်ပြီး reason = error စာ၊ event detail = API name/kind/attempts/detail ရေးတယ် (2026-11-28 ပြင်)။ RT External API fail ကို API_UNREACHABLE run၊ CPEMS fail ကို bcs_update_failed အဖြစ် မှတ်တယ်။
note_en: Node-RED failures are recorded with api, kind (timeout / unreachable / http_status / invalid_response), attempts, cpe_id and HTTP status in the event detail, the error as the reason and FAILED_PERMANENT as the result; RT External API and CPEMS failures were already recorded. Added 2026-11-28.

tests.name: TestNewProducerDSN_DeliverySettings
tests.asserts: producer config: Retries "2" (3 sends in total, the PO's reading of the AC), idempotent with acks=all (a retry never duplicates the decision), message timeout 4s and below Produce's 5s wait

tests.name: TestGuard_PublishPathIsGuardedAtEveryStep
tests.asserts: decision is produced once and the run moves to PUBLISHED

how_mm: Workflow ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ကို Produce နဲ့ Kafka ပို့တယ်။ App မှာ retry loop မရှိဘဲ librdkafka producer config (newProducerDSN) — Retries="2" (ပထမ ပို့တာ + retry ၂ ကြိမ် = စုစုပေါင်း ၃ ကြိမ်၊ PO ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက် 2026-11-28)၊ idempotent၊ message timeout 4s — ပေါ်မှာ မှီတယ်။ Setting တွေကို test စစ်တယ်။
note_en: Retries=2 (3 sends in total, as the PO decided on 2026-11-28), idempotent, 4 s timeout: the settings are tested. The retry itself is librdkafka's and needs a real broker to observe.

tests.name: TestRetryDisabled_PublishFailureKeepsPayloadAndClosesRun
tests.asserts: RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false (deployed config, child process) and Kafka failing: Produce called once, no retry job, run FETCHING_CPE_STATUS -> WORKFLOW_EVALUATED -> FAILED_PERMANENT (never PUBLISHED); the workflow_evaluated detail keeps the payload (event-1, Resolved); event kafka_publish_failed_retry_disabled with the Kafka error as reason

tests.name: TestRecord_WorkflowEvaluatedKeepsResponseAndDecision
tests.asserts: WORKFLOW_EVALUATED detail holds the whole Node-RED response and the workflow decision (the payload to publish)

tests.name: TestCrash_BeforeProduce_SweeperClosesRun
tests.asserts: INTEGRATION (real DB): workflow_evaluated event holds the full payload before Produce; sweeper then closes run FAILED_PERMANENT

tests.name: TestPipelineRetryRepository_ScheduleRetryFromState
tests.asserts: sqlmock: retry job not written when run moved on / missing (only refusal cases)

how_mm: Publish မတိုင်ခင် WORKFLOW_EVALUATED event detail ထဲ payload အပြည့် သိမ်းထားတယ်။ Publish fail ရင် error log ရေးပြီး RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false (deploy config) မှာ run ကို FAILED_PERMANENT (kafka_publish_failed_retry_disabled) နဲ့ Kafka error ကို reason အဖြစ် မှတ်ပြီး ပိတ်တယ်။ Fail ဖြစ်တဲ့ fake Kafka နဲ့ test စစ်တယ်။
note_en: With a failing fake Kafka and the deployed RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false: the payload stays in the workflow_evaluated event, and the run is closed FAILED_PERMANENT with the Kafka error as the reason.

tests.name: TestRetryDisabled_PublishFailureKeepsPayloadAndClosesRun
tests.asserts: RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false (deployed config, child process) and Kafka failing: Produce called once, no retry job, run FETCHING_CPE_STATUS -> WORKFLOW_EVALUATED -> FAILED_PERMANENT (never PUBLISHED); the workflow_evaluated detail keeps the payload (event-1, Resolved); event kafka_publish_failed_retry_disabled with the Kafka error as reason

tests.asserts: a run stuck in WORKFLOW_EVALUATED is closed FAILED_PERMANENT with workflow_publish_timeout

tests.name: TestNocAutomationReport_RunItems

how_mm: RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false ဖြစ်လို့ publish fail ရင် run ကို FAILED_PERMANENT ပိတ်ပြီး report မှာ Manual Check ပြတယ်။ ပိတ်မသွားရင် sweeper က WORKFLOW_EVALUATED ကြာနေတာကို FAILED_PERMANENT ပိတ်တယ်။ လမ်း ၂ ခုလုံး test ရှိတယ်။
note_en: The direct failed-publish -> FAILED_PERMANENT path (retries off), the sweeper safety net and the Manual Check mapping are all tested.

how_mm: pipeline_runs row တစ်ခုမှာ ticket_id, cpe_id, before_queue/target_queue, last_state_reason, created/updated/completed_at ရှိပြီး pipeline_run_events မှာ step တိုင်း မှတ်တယ်။ Node-RED fail နဲ့ Kafka publish fail ဖြစ်တဲ့ run record မှာ field အကုန် ပါကြောင်း test တစ်ခုတည်းက စစ်တယ်။ created_at က insert မှာ၊ completed_at က FAILED_PERMANENT ပြောင်းချိန်မှာ repository က ရေးတယ် (rtdatacore test)။
note_en: One test checks the failed run record of both failures (Node-RED fetch, Kafka publish) carries the ticket, CPE, queues, message and failed step; created_at / completed_at are set by the repository (rtdatacore tests).

tests.name: TestProduce_FailureSaysTopicAndAttempts
tests.asserts: Kafka send failing (message timed out / wait cut off / broker refused) -> APIFailure kafka with the topic, 3 attempts (first send + Retries=2), kind timeout or delivery_failed, the producer error wrapped; event detail carries them

tests.name: TestRetryDisabled_FailedRunRecordHasRequiredFields
tests.asserts: with retries off, the FAILED_PERMANENT event of a Node-RED failure has detail {api node_red, kind, attempts 3, cpe_id, http_status, error} and of a Kafka failure {api kafka, kind, attempts 3, topic, error}, reason = the error

how_mm: Kafka Produce fail ရင် APIFailure (api kafka၊ topic၊ attempts = ပထမ ပို့တာ + Retries = 3၊ kind timeout/delivery_failed) ပြန်ပေးတယ်။ RETRY_WORKER_ENABLED=false မှာ run ကို FAILED_PERMANENT (kafka_publish_failed_retry_disabled) ပိတ်ပြီး reason = error စာ၊ event detail = topic/attempts/kind/error ရေးတယ် (2026-11-28 ပြင်)။
note_en: A failed publish is recorded with the topic, the attempts (3), the kind and the error in the event detail, the error as the reason and FAILED_PERMANENT as the result. Added 2026-11-28.

tests.name: TestProcessTicket_BCSOnlyForRemoteResolve
tests.asserts: with a fake Peppermint: Remote Resolve -> one POST /api/v2/cpes/{cpe}/channel-selections (2.4g, X-Request-ID = run_id), run through BCS_UPDATING, job_id recorded; routing rule, Node-RED error, or a Remote Resolve ticket already Resolved (skipped) -> BCS never called

tests.name: TestStartBestChannelSelection_RetriesExhausted
tests.asserts: 5xx retried up to configured 3 calls then error

how_mm: rtutil က Kafka message ရဲ့ is_remote_resolved=true ဖြစ်ပြီး ticket skip မဖြစ်၊ run_id ပါရင် BCS_UPDATING ပြောင်းကာ CPEMS/Peppermint ကို 2.4g channel selection POST ပို့ပြီး job_id မှတ်တယ်။ Remote Resolve မှာပဲ စပြီး တခြား ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်/skip မှာ မစတာကို test စစ်တယ်။
note_en: Both the Peppermint request and the "only when Remote Resolve" gate (routing, Node-RED error and skipped tickets get no BCS) are unit tested.

tests.name: TestParseBCSWebhook_SuccessMessage

tests.name: TestParseBCSWebhook_Failed

tests.name: TestParseBCSWebhook_SkippedAndUnconfirmed
tests.asserts: skipped -> bcs_update_skipped, "Skipped" / "Skipped (CONFIG_SERVICE_MIGRATED:…)" (its own outcome, AC42); unconfirmed -> bcs_update_failed "Failed (unconfirmed)"; is_bcs_success false for both

tests.name: TestBCSJobResult_TimeoutBeforeSendIsFailed
tests.asserts: a failed job with error TIMEOUT_BEFORE_SEND -> is_bcs_success false, bcs_update_failed, "Failed (TIMEOUT_BEFORE_SEND:job not sent within 300s)" (no separate Timeout result), from the webhook and the result sweeper poll alike

tests.name: TestBCSResultSweeper_SweepOnce
tests.asserts: poller records the same outcomes as the webhook (skipped as Skipped); stuck jobs give up as failed (bcs_result_gave_up)

tests.name: TestCaseTotal
tests.asserts: the report has a BCS skipped case and count of its own (bcs_skipped), apart from BCS failed

how_mm: Webhook နဲ့ result sweeper နှစ်ခုလုံး BCSJobResultInput သုံးပြီး succeeded_new_channel → "Success (new channel)"၊ succeeded_same_channel → "Success (same channel)"၊ failed/unconfirmed → "Failed (reason)"၊ skipped → "Skipped (reason)" (event bcs_update_skipped) မှတ်တယ်။ TIMEOUT_BEFORE_SEND က "Failed (TIMEOUT_BEFORE_SEND:…)"၊ Timeout ရလဒ် သီးသန့် မရှိ။ Skipped/Failed နှစ်ခုလုံး channel မပြောင်းလို့ is_bcs_success=false ဖြစ်ပြီး pipeline_report က bcs_status_message "Skipped" နဲ့ ခွဲပြီး "BCS skipped" သီးသန့် ပြတယ် (2026-11-28 AC အတိုင်း ပြင်)။
note_en: All four outcomes are recorded as the AC names them: Success (new/same channel), Failed (incl. TIMEOUT_BEFORE_SEND with its reason, no Timeout result) and Skipped (bcs_update_skipped, counted apart in pipeline_report). Changed to match the AC on 2026-11-28.

tests.name: TestPipelineRunRepository_TransitionState_TicketCompleted
tests.asserts: RT update -> TICKET_COMPLETED when BCS null/failed, FULLY_COMPLETED when BCS succeeded earlier or in same transition

tests.name: TestPipelineRunRepository_RecordBCSResult
tests.asserts: BCS success on TICKET_COMPLETED run -> FULLY_COMPLETED; failure stays TICKET_COMPLETED; success before ticket done leaves state

tests.name: TestCompletePipelineRun_OpenRunHasNoLateEvent
tests.asserts: rtutil completes an open run as TICKET_COMPLETED

how_mm: RT update ပြီးရင် rtutil က TICKET_COMPLETED ရေးပြီး BCS အောင်ပြီးသားဆို repo က FULLY_COMPLETED ပြောင်းသည်။ BCS result နောက်မှရောက်ပြီး အောင်ရင် TICKET_COMPLETED -> FULLY_COMPLETED၊ fail/skip ဆို TICKET_COMPLETED မှာ ကျန်ပြီး RT ကို ထပ်မထိ။
note_en: TICKET_COMPLETED vs FULLY_COMPLETED in both orders (BCS before/after RT update) is asserted with sqlmock.
